scenarios.name: Accept distinct parameter values for model-state members

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
The MCAD Software has a part with Primary, Capture State, and Copy State model states
an extrusion has a length parameter d0 of 1 in in each state
the model-state table does not include d0 among its chosen parameters
Copy State is active
the user opens the model-state table
adds d0 from the extrusion to the chosen parameters
changes the Copy State d0 cell to 2 in
accepts the table
reopens the model-state table
d0 is listed among the chosen parameters
the Copy State d0 cell displays 2 in
the Primary and Capture State d0 cells display 1 in
the parameter tree displays d0 as 2 in
the user closes the table and activates Primary
the user reopens the model-state table
the parameter tree displays d0 as 1 in
the Copy State d0 cell still displays 2 in
the Primary and Capture State d0 cells still display 1 in
